quest.title: Moonlight Sonata
quest.description: The Damselette is having a spot of trouble in the Silvermoon Hall...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Greetings.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Are you heading out, Columbina?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Yes. I need to get a lyre repaired.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...What?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: One of the kuuhenki's lyres is broken. She greatly values this lyre, so I wish to have it restored.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Man, kuuhenki sure are multi-talented...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Of course. This little one often performs around here, and I sometimes sing along.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Y'know, Paimon's been thinking this for a while, but you sure do spoil the kuuhenki.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Well, it's only right. They have kept me company all this time, and often bring me amusing objects as well.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Lauma told me about this before — the natural instinct of kuuhenki to make the Moon Goddesses happy.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If you don't mind Paimon asking, how do you plan to fix this lyre? Didn't you say you didn't want to be seen by others?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Hmm... In the past, small animals or kuuhenki would help deliver broken objects to an artisan's doorstep for me.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: All I had to do was wait for the artisan to find it. Of course, sometimes, that would take a few days.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems like a roundabout way of doing things...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why don't you let us handle it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, just leave it to us. Who knows, we might even be able to get this done today.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: ...Very well. Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Our pleasure! By the way, what artisan do you usually bring your stuff to?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: I don't know her name, but there's a large mechanical hand by her door, and she lives in a round, conch-like home.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Wait, she must mean...)

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: The aroma of krumkakes often wafts from within as well.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yep, that clears it up for sure...

talks.objective: Go to the Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aino? Are you home?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Wait, Paimon? Is that you?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: What brings you here, guys? Bring me any snacks?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon knew you'd say that! Here, we got you these on the way.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Quick, hand 'em over! Ineffa's gonna be back soon.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: So, you here to hang out? What sorta fun things should we do?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe... Actually, we need your help with something...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Waaah! Get... Get that weird thing away from me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Weird thing"? You mean this lyre?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I told you, I don't mess with stuff that science and mechanics can't explain...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I'm telling you, that lyre just... shows up on my doorstep at random. And, after I fix it, the thing up and disappears!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: N—Not that I believe in spooky, superstitious stuff like that!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, okay... Seems like there's some sort of misunderstanding here...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: What do you mean?

choices.text: This lyre belongs to a friend...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah. She doesn't mean any harm, she just... has her reasons for taking the lyre back without being seen...

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Really? You better not be making this up.

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Fine. I'm... I'm trusting you on this! I'll fix this thing for you, and this time, I'll try to make it last...

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Wait for me here. I'll be right back.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Knew we could count on Aino! Paimon feels a little bad Columbina's random item drop-offs had her so freaked out though...

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: Yes, she deserves something in return.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactl— Aaah! What are you doing here!? You scared us!

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: I have something to give you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm? What are these?

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: A few trinkets the kuuhenki collected. I thought the artisan might like them. Perhaps you could give them to her as thanks.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ohhh... What a weird collection of components. Yeah, alright! We'll pass 'em along!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Take care on your way back! There could be people around here.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Paimon...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? What is it?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Over there...

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: ...Analyzing appearance...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What are you doing that for!?

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Match found: Resemblance to Nod-Krai Moon Goddess Statues is 95%...

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: #Increased heart rate detected in "{NICKNAME}"...

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Okay, all fixed! Did a pretty bang up job, if I do say so myself. It shouldn't break ever again! Also, about those sna— O—Oh! I—Ineffa...!

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: What was that last part, Aino?

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Uh, those sna... zzy new components worked great, too!

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Uh, who's that behind you?

choices.text: The person who needed the lyre fixed!

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: (Huh, she kinda looks familiar... Have I seen her before? Eh, whatever. The most important thing is, I hid those snacks Paimon gave me...)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Th—That's right! Also, she wanted you to have these components as thanks for fixing the lyre, Aino.

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Ooh, lemme see... Wow! These are rare, and so old! You sure I can take them?

response.speaker: The Damselette
response.text: ...Yes.

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Thank you so much! If you ever need anything else fixed, just come find me — no need to be shy!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, um... We've got places to be, so uh... Aino, Ineffa, we'll swing by some other day, okay?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (We've gotta get The Damselette outta here, or Ineffa will recognize her for sure!)

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Oh, sure! See you some other time!

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: (I've gotta do some cleanup quick, or Ineffa's gonna find the snack crumbs!)

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Alright. Until next time.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: ...Aino.

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Uh... yeah?

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Would you like to frame these components or preserve them in any way?

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: What? Why would I do that?

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: They appear to be "gifts from the Moon Goddess."

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Huh? What are you talking about...? Remind me to check your circuits later...

choices.text: What about the, uh, margin of error?

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Margin of error minimal. Inference assessment: Accurate...

choices.text: A friend who's a bit scared of strangers...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: You appear acquainted with that artisan. I shall await you here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Hmm? Music from a lyre? It seems Columbina is playing for the kuuhenki.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (The last time we popped by, the lyre hadn't been repaired yet. That was well before Columbina got to know everyone...)

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Not long ago...
